title: Keyword Search
preconditions: User is on the CX candidate portal's job list / search page
steps:
1. Search using a keyword unique to a specific job.
2. Review results.

stepsFormatted.content: Search using a keyword unique to a specific job.

stepsFormatted.expected: Only jobs matching the keyword are returned (per configured search scope — title/description/etc.).

expectedResult: Only jobs matching the keyword are returned (per configured search scope — title/description/etc.).
notes: On the CX portal, confirm a keyword search returns only jobs whose title/description actually contain that keyword.
